system.description:
You raise and spin your weapon before holding it into a stance meant to infuse your fury into it. While in this stance the first time each turn that your deal your [Weapons damage] you can gain Fury.

| Binding Fury Stance – Fury / A Creature with Fury is also known as a Furious creature, a special state unique to users of Power weapons. A Furious creature emits a soft and ominous red mist from their pores. A Furious creature retains the Fury it has until the end of the following turn they gained the state. A Furious creature can spend this stored fury to cast or enhance another Bukijutsu that calls for it. Spending Fury in this way happens before you deal damage with the chosen jutsu. |
